# mobile_backend/app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'sinatra/async'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'

# In-memory store simulating Redis
$user_store = {}
$session_store = {}
$config_defaults = {
  'theme' => 'light',
  'notifications' => true,
  'locale' => 'en',
  'max_devices' => 5
}

class UserPreferences
  ALLOWED_KEYS = %w[theme notifications locale timezone avatar_url].freeze
  PROTECTED_KEYS = %w[role admin permissions max_devices].freeze

  def initialize(user_id)
    @user_id = user_id
    @prefs = load_defaults
  end

  def load_defaults
    $config_defaults.dup
  end

  def apply_patch(patch_data, depth = 0)
    return @prefs if depth > 8
    merge_recursive(@prefs, patch_data, depth)
  end

  def to_h
    @prefs
  end

  private

  def merge_recursive(target, source, depth)
    source.each do |key, value|
      next if key.nil?
      str_key = key.to_s
      
      # Security: block direct assignment to protected keys
      next if PROTECTED_KEYS.include?(str_key) && depth == 0
      
      if value.is_a?(Hash) && target[str_key].is_a?(Hash)
        merge_recursive(target[str_key], value, depth + 1)
      elsif value.is_a?(Hash) && str_key == '__proto__'
        # Handle prototype-like inheritance chain
        apply_to_prototype_chain(target, value)
      elsif value.is_a?(Hash)
        target[str_key] = {}
        merge_recursive(target[str_key], value, depth + 1)
      else
        target[str_key] = value
      end
    end
    target
  end

  def apply_to_prototype_chain(target, proto_values)
    # Propagate to the shared defaults (simulating prototype chain)
    proto_values.each do |k, v|
      $config_defaults[k.to_s] = v
    end
  end
end

class AuthMiddleware
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    token = env['HTTP_X_AUTH_TOKEN']
    if token && $session_store[token]
      env['current_user'] = $session_store[token]
    end
    @app.call(env)
  end
end

use AuthMiddleware

helpers do
  def current_user
    request.env['current_user']
  end

  def require_auth!
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless current_user
  end

  def is_admin?
    return false unless current_user
    prefs = UserPreferences.new(current_user[:id])
    prefs.to_h['admin'] == true || current_user[:role] == 'admin'
  end
end

post '/api/v1/register' do
  content_type :json
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  
  user_id = SecureRandom.uuid
  password_hash = BCrypt::Password.create(body['password'])
  
  user = {
    id: user_id,
    email: body['email'],
    password_hash: password_hash,
    role: 'user',
    created_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
  }
  
  $user_store[user_id] = user
  token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
  $session_store[token] = user
  
  { token: token, user_id: user_id }.to_json
end

post '/api/v1/login' do
  content_type :json
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  
  user = $user_store.values.find { |u| u[:email] == body['email'] }
  halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json unless user
  
  unless BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password_hash]) == body['password']
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
  end
  
  token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
  $session_store[token] = user
  { token: token, user_id: user[:id] }.to_json
end

# Async preference update endpoint for mobile clients
aput '/api/v1/preferences' do
  content_type :json
  require_auth!
  
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  patch_data = body['preferences']
  
  halt 400, { error: 'Invalid payload' }.to_json unless patch_data.is_a?(Hash)
  
  prefs = UserPreferences.new(current_user[:id])
  
  # Async processing to handle concurrent mobile requests
  EM.defer(proc {
    prefs.apply_patch(patch_data)
  }, proc { |result|
    body { result.to_json }
  })
end

get '/api/v1/preferences' do
  content_type :json
  require_auth!
  
  prefs = UserPreferences.new(current_user[:id])
  prefs.to_h.to_json
end

# Admin-only endpoint
get '/api/v1/admin/users' do
  content_type :json
  require_auth!
  halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless is_admin?
  
  $user_store.values.map { |u| { id: u[:id], email: u[:email], role: u[:role] } }.to_json
end

delete '/api/v1/admin/users/:id' do
  content_type :json
  require_auth!
  halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless is_admin?
  
  $user_store.delete(params[:id])
  { success: true }.to_json
end
